class.name: OcgShapeupgradeShellsewing
class.brief_description: This class provides a tool for applying sewing algorithm from BRepBuilderAPI: it takes a shape, calls sewing for each shell, and then replaces sewed shells with use of ShapeBuild_ReShape
class.description: ! This class provides a tool for applying sewing algorithm from ! BRepBuilderAPI: it takes a shape, calls sewing for each shell, ! and then replaces sewed shells with use of ShapeBuild_ReShape

method.name: ApplySewing
method.description: Builds a new shape from a former one, by calling Sewing from BRepBuilderAPI. Rebuilt solids are oriented to be "not infinite"
